pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā anuruddho kosalesu janapadesu sāvatthiṃ gacchanto sāyaṃ aññataraṃ gāmaṃ upagacchi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.3: tena kho pana samayena tasmiṃ gāme aññatarissā itthiyā āvasathāgāraṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.4: athakho āyasmā anuruddho yena sā itthī tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā taṃ itthiṃ etadavoca sace te bhagini agaru vaseyyāmi ekarattiṃ āvasathāgāreti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.6: aññepi addhikā yena sā itthī tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā taṃ itthiṃ etadavocuṃ sace te ayye agaru vaseyyāma ekarattiṃ āvasathāgāreti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.7: eso kho ayyo samaṇo paṭhamaṃ upagato sace so anujānāti vaseyyāthāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.8: athakho te addhikā yenāyasmā anuruddho tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavocuṃ sace te bhante agaru vaseyyāma ekarattiṃ āvasathāgāreti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.10: athakho sā itthī āyasmante anuruddhe saha dassanena paṭibaddhacittā ahosi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.11: athakho sā itthī yenāyasmā anuruddho tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca ayyo bhante imehi manussehi ākiṇṇo na phāsu viharissati
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.12: sādhāhaṃ bhante ayyassa mañcakaṃ abbhantaraṃ paññāpeyyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.14: athakho sā itthī āyasmato anuruddhassa sāmaṃ mañcakaṃ abbhantaraṃ paññāpetvā alaṅkatapaṭiyattā gandhagandhinī yenāyasmā anuruddho tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.15: ayyo bhante abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko ahañcamhi abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.17: evaṃ vutte āyasmā anuruddho tuṇhī ahosi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.19: tatiyampi kho sā atthī āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.20: ayyo bhante abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko ahañcamhi abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.21: sādhu bhante ayyo mañceva sampaṭicchatu sabbañca sāpateyyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.22: tatiyampi kho āyasmā anuruddho tuṇhī ahosi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.23: athakho sā itthī sāṭakaṃ nikkhipitvā āyasmato anuruddhassa purato caṅkamatipi tiṭṭhatipi nisīdatipi seyyaṃpi kappeti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.24: athakho āyasmā anuruddho indriyāni okkhipitvā taṃ itthiṃ neva olokesi napi ālapi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.25: athakho sā itthī acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhūtaṃ vata bho
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.26: bahū me manussā satenapi sahassenapi pahīṇanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.27: ayaṃ pana samaṇo mayā sāmaṃ yāciyamāno na icchati mañceva sampaṭicchituṃ sabbañca sāpateyyanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.28: sāṭakaṃ nivāsetvā āyasmato anuruddhassa pādesu sirasā nipatitvā āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.29: accayo maṃ bhante accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ yāhaṃ evarūpamakāsiṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.30: tassā me bhante ayyo accayaṃ accayato paṭiggaṇhātu āyatiṃ saṃvarāyāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.31: iṅgha taṃ bhagini accayo accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ yā tvaṃ evamakāsi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.32: yato ca kho tvaṃ bhagini accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikarosi tante mayaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.33: vuḍḍhi hesā bhagini ariyassa vinaye yo accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikaroti āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.34: athakho sā itthī tassā rattiyā accayena āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.35: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho taṃ itthiṃ āyasmā anuruddho dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.36: athakho sā itthī āyasmatā anuruddhena dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā samādapitā samuttejitā sampahaṃsitā āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.38: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telappajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.39: evamevaṃ ayyena anuruddhena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.40: esāhaṃ bhante taṃ bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.41: upāsikaṃ maṃ ayyo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.42: athakho āyasmā anuruddho sāvatthiṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.43: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.44: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā anuruddho mātugāmena saha seyyaṃ kappessatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.45: athakho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.46: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ anuruddha mātugāmena saha seyyaṃ kappesīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.48: vigarahi buddho bhagavā kathaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ anuruddha mātugāmena saha seyyaṃ kappessasi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.50: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.51.1: yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmena saha seyyaṃ kappeyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:2.1.6: manussitthī na yakkhī na petī na tiracchānagatā antamaso tadahujātāpi dārikā pageva mahantatarī.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:2.1.13: mātugāme nipanne bhikkhu nipajjati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:2.1.14: bhikkhu nipanne mātugāme nipajjati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:2.2.1: mātugāme mātugāmasaññī saha seyyaṃ kappeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:2.2.2: mātugāme vematiko saha seyyaṃ kappeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:2.2.3: mātugāme amātugāmasaññī saha seyyaṃ kappeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:2.2.5: yakkhiyā vā petiyā vā paṇḍakena vā tiracchānagatitthiyā vā saha seyyaṃ kappeti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
